content.title: About
content.content: Pie with peanut butter cream is a dessert consisting of a tender crust, a layer of smooth peanut butter cream, and often topped with glaze or nut crumbs. The peanut butter cream gives a sweet, nutty flavor and creamy texture, while the crust provides a light, crisp bite.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Peanut butter cream is usually made from roasted peanuts, sugar, and oil, sometimes with a pinch of salt for balance.
Nut‑filled pies are popular in the United States, often served at holidays and family gatherings.
The contrast between sweet crust and slightly salty peanut butter cream is a favorite among dessert lovers.
Some recipes add chocolate or caramel to the cream for an extra rich taste.

items.title: Plant‑based protein source
items.content: Peanut butter cream provides a notable amount of protein, important for tissue repair.

items.title: Healthy monounsaturated fats
items.content: Peanuts are rich in monounsaturated fats that may support heart health when consumed in moderation.

items.title: B‑vitamins
items.content: Peanuts contain niacin, folate, and vitamin B6, which play roles in energy metabolism.

items.title: Magnesium and phosphorus
items.content: These minerals help maintain normal muscle and bone function.

items.title: Antioxidants
items.content: Resveratrol and other phytochemicals in peanuts help combat free radicals.

items.title: Peanut allergy
items.content: Peanuts are a strong allergen; individuals with peanut allergy may experience severe reactions.

items.title: High calorie content
items.content: Pie with peanut butter cream is calorie‑dense, so portion control is advisable.

items.title: Sugar content
items.content: Sugar in the crust and cream can raise blood glucose levels; people with diabetes should limit intake.

items.title: Salt
items.content: Some recipes add salt to the cream, which may be a concern for those with hypertension.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Serve the pie as a dessert with tea or coffee, cut into portions, and keep refrigerated. It can also be gently warmed in the microwave to soften the cream.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the pie in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 5 days. For longer storage, freeze it wrapped in plastic film and foil; thaw at room temperature before serving.
